verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs explicitly describe hybrid search as combining full-text (keyword) and semantic (vector) search in a single query, with automatic embedding generation and no manual embedding management, and a dedicated product page reiterates this capability. Community evidence corroborates general production reliability of Meilisearch's search features, though no independent hands-on report specifically validates hybrid search quality. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically of hybrid search fusion behavior (most corroboration covers full-text/indexing performance, not hybrid semantic fusion).
